All done. Summary of what I did:

1. **Diagnosed the issue**: checkout-api was on v2.3.1 and unhealthy in all three production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with an 18% error rate.

2. **Rolled back**: The first rollback attempt partially failed after us-east (orchestrator error), so I inspected state and retried — all regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) are now on **v2.3.0**, the most recent release that was healthy in production.

3. **Verified recovery**: checkout-api is now **healthy** with the error rate down to ~0.2%.

4. **Opened incident INC-0001 (SEV2)** describing the failure and the rollback. (The initial create_incident request timed out, but I confirmed via the incident list that it did register, so no retry was needed.)
